outputs.explanation: This panel is a single representative spatial-cluster image of one lung section; it does not present averaged, summary-statistic, or statistically tested data that would require replicate reporting.

This panel shows a representative H&E image and its manual region annotation from the same single section shown in A; no quantitative/statistical data are presented that would require replicate reporting.
This panel shows representative H&E and spatial mRNA-expression maps from the same single section; it is descriptive/representative imaging, not a summary statistic requiring replicate reporting.

replicate_statements: The nominal P and FDR values were obtained from the "GSEA Preranked" tool (from Broad Institute) using a weighted scoring scheme.
Gene sets were evaluated based on the default normalized enrichment score method, and statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations.
outputs.explanation: This panel reports NES, FDR and P values from a GSEA comparison of T11b-high (S1&S2) versus T11b-low (S3) squamous tumor regions, i.e., a statistical comparison. The caption describes the permutation method (1000 permutations) used to compute significance but does not state the number of underlying observations/spots being compared per group (S1, S2, S3) or clarify what constitutes a replicate/sample in this analysis, so neither the n-number nor the replicate type is reported.

replicate_statements: Differential gene expression was calculated using Seurat’s FindAllMarkers function, and direct comparisons between two classes and corresponding P values were obtained using Seurat’s FindMarkers function with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction.
outputs.explanation: The bar graph reports fold changes and p-values from a Wilcoxon rank-sum test comparing Tmprss11b-high versus low LUSC spatial transcriptomics data, which is a statistical comparison requiring a defined sample size. The caption names the statistical test but does not report how many spots/observations were compared in each group, nor what type of replicate (e.g., spots, regions, sections) these represent.
